stem.text: A loudspeaker emitting a sound wave of a single frequency is placed a distance $L$ from a reflecting surface, as shown.

stem.alt: Loudspeaker on the left and a reflector on the right, joined by a dashed horizontal line with a double-headed arrow labelled L above, a microphone with an arrow pointing right, and the label path of microphone.

stem.text: A stationary wave is formed with an antinode at the loudspeaker. A microphone is moved from the loudspeaker to the reflector.
Before the microphone reaches the reflector, it detects four points where the sound intensity is a minimum.
What is the wavelength of the sound wave?
